speaker: A
text: We closed 12 deals last quarter entirely through outbound.

speaker: A
text: No paid ads, no inbound leads — just signals and sequences.

speaker: A
text: The secret was custom intent signals.

speaker: A
text: Instead of watching generic job-change alerts, we built our own signal around one specific trigger: companies that added a VP of Sales in the last 30 days.

speaker: A
text: That one signal converted at 4× our baseline.

speaker: A
text: A new VP of Sales has 90 days to prove they can build pipeline.

speaker: A
text: They are actively looking for tools, and they have budget authority right away.

speaker: A
text: We layered on a second signal: companies that posted an open SDR role in the same 30-day window.

speaker: A
text: If a company is hiring sellers and just brought in a new VP, they are building a team and they need a platform.

speaker: A
text: The result was 23 meetings in one month from a list of under 400 accounts.

speaker: A
text: That is a 5.75 percent meeting rate on cold outbound, which is about 10× the industry average.
